era.title: Deep Space and Post-Human Transition
era.subtitle: Humanity expands into the outer frontier while identity, bodies, and minds transform
era.description: This era explores deep-space civilization, outer-system industry, post-human law, digital humans, mind-state transfer, multiple body formats, alien biochemistry, and the first confirmed signal from non-human intelligence.

seo.metaTitle: Era 6: Deep Space and Post-Human Transition | Future Civilization Roadmap
seo.metaDescription: Explore deep-space civilization and post-human transition through safe hibernation, Europa biochemistry, mind-state transfer, digital humans, AI civilizations, synthetic planets, and non-human signal confirmation.

items.title: Human hibernation becomes safe for deep-space travel

items.civilizationImpact: Deep-space travel becomes more practical, allowing humans to cross vast distances while reducing life-support burden, psychological stress, and mission cost.
signals: Long-duration hibernation trials show safe revival and cognitive preservation
Starship medical systems manage metabolism and immune function autonomously
Space agencies certify hibernation protocols for outer-system missions
implications: Lower cost for deep-space crewed missions
More realistic settlement beyond Mars and the asteroid belt
New ethics around consent, time loss, and medical autonomy
